reordering_letters_does_not_move_the_spa.detail: one trained model read under two row orders. This metric asserts that and nothing else -- in particular it does NOT demand that every abstaining row decode as abstain, which this corpus forbids (see abstention_decoded_where_answer_rs_reads_it.span). _counterfactual_holds is the single owner and main() calls the same function for the exit status, so the row and the exit status cannot disagree -- which is what GAP-FT-TOY-VERDICT-ROW-CONTRADICTED-ITS-OWN-RUN was about, reproduced here before this fix.
